generatedAt.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

id.description: Salidium's session id. Opaque: use it only to build report URLs, percent-encoded as one path segment.

provider.description: claude-code, codex, or a namespaced owner/name extension provider.

sessionId.description: The provider's own session id, exactly as the provider wrote it.

native.description: The key any tool that launched a session already has. Look a session up by it with the lookup endpoint.

title.description: The provider's own session title. Null when the provider gave none: Salidium's interface falls back to the first line of the prompt, and prompts are not part of this contract.

cwd.description: Working directory the provider recorded for the session.

repositoryRoot.description: Git repository root, when Salidium observed one. Null is not "not a repository".

status.description: As of generatedAt. A working session silent for fifteen minutes reads idle, so status can change with time alone.

anyOf.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.
UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.
UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

evidenceSeq.description: Sequence of the newest evidence this entry reflects. It only grows for a given session; a larger value means the report changed.

linesRemovedExact.description: False when a provider replaced some file without recording what it held, so linesRemoved is a lower bound rather than a count. Added in 1.1.

reviewOpen.description: Open review items above informational severity.

remaining.description: Plan steps still pending or in progress.

at.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

provenance.description: How Salidium knows this value. Render the classes differently; never merge them.

lastVerification.description: The most recent check Salidium recognized, in run order. Null when none ran.

explanation.description: Outcome of the most recent explanation attempt; none when there has been no attempt. Whether an explanation covers the newest evidence is the report field explanation.current.

provenance.description: How Salidium knows this value. Render the classes differently; never merge them.

anyOf.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

provenance.description: A statement is always something the agent said. Findings are elsewhere.

author.description: Who said it. Nothing the user wrote crosses this contract.

anyOf.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

latestStatement.description: The agent's latest statement about its work, quoted and attributed.

since.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

provenance.description: observed for a permission request, a provider notification, or a question tool call; reported when Salidium read the question in the agent message. The verdict follows it.

root.description: The repository this anchor read, as Git reported its top level. A session can move between repositories, so this can differ from session.repositoryRoot and between the two anchors. Null when it could not cross whole.

head.description: The full commit id HEAD named. Null for a repository with no commits yet.

branch.description: The checked-out branch. Null for a detached HEAD.

at.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

atStart.description: When the session started. Kept from the first start Salidium watched. A resume, clear, or compaction does not count as a start, so a session Salidium first watched after it started has none.

root.description: The repository this anchor read, as Git reported its top level. A session can move between repositories, so this can differ from session.repositoryRoot and between the two anchors. Null when it could not cross whole.

head.description: The full commit id HEAD named. Null for a repository with no commits yet.

branch.description: The checked-out branch. Null for a detached HEAD.

at.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

atLatestTurnEnd.description: When the most recent turn ended. Commits made since then are in changes.commits.

revision.description: Which revision the work started from and stands at, each in the repository its root names. Each anchor is null when Salidium did not watch that boundary live: history imports, sessions that began before Salidium was running, or git observation turned off. Added in 1.1.

root.description: Top level of the Git working tree that holds the file.

path.description: The file relative to root, with / separators.

mainRoot.description: When root is a linked worktree, the repository it belongs to: the working tree that owns the shared Git directory, or that directory itself for a bare repository. Null for a main working tree.

anyOf.description: Resolved from Git pointer files on disk when the change was live, without running git. Null when no repository held the file, when the change was imported from history, or when Salidium could not tell; nothing is guessed. Added in 1.1.

linesRemovedExact.description: False when some change replaced this file without recording what it held, so linesRemoved is a lower bound. Added in 1.1.

lastChangedAt.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

by.description: Label of the covering check, when there is one.

coverage.description: Whether a full-scope passing test, build, or typecheck ran after the last change. Always inferred: a run covering a file is a heuristic.

provenance.description: A statement is always something the agent said. Findings are elsewhere.

author.description: Who said it. Nothing the user wrote crosses this contract.

anyOf.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

reason.description: Nearest rationale the agent gave before the change, bound to the file by time. Always reported, and the binding itself is a heuristic.

at.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.
UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

observation.description: Claude Code records no exit code for a successful command and Codex can hide nested codes; unknown is a result, not zero.

statements.description: What the agent said about verification. Reported, not observed.

rule.description: Stable rule id, e.g. verification-failed or destructive:rm-rf.

latestAt.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

instance.description: The short fragment that is the finding itself, e.g. the destructive command segment. Clipped and redacted.

createdAt.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

provenance.description: How Salidium knows this value. Render the classes differently; never merge them.

groups.description: Worst severity first, most recent within it.

provenance.description: How Salidium knows this value. Render the classes differently; never merge them.

status.description: Outcome of the most recent explanation attempt; none when there has been no attempt. Whether an explanation covers the newest evidence is the report field explanation.current.

current.description: The content covers the newest evidence. False when content is null.

anyOf.description: UTC, millisecond precision, trailing Z. Lexicographic order is time order.

content.description: The newest generated Why and How. Present with status generating or failed when an older explanation exists.

explanation.description: Optional model-written narrative. Salidium never calls a model because a consumer read a report.

usage.description: Observed tokens only. Null, never zeroes, when none were observed.

redactions.description: Credential-shaped spans Salidium removed at ingest.
